assumptions.statement: The site and key-area polygons are repository-maintained provisional constraints because no coordinate-verified official redline is included in the cleared site package.
assumptions.impact: All geometry-derived area values, maps, and phase bands are reproducible intake readings and must be regenerated after official CAD/GIS/PDF geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage limits, municipal utilities, fire access, parking, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package proposes spatial relationships and review questions, but does not claim FAR, height, density, setback, road, ownership, or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Design layers are generated by clipping conceptual corridors, bands, nodes, and footprints to the provisional site polygon; they describe spatial supply relationships rather than surveyed existing conditions.
assumptions.impact: The layers can be checked for topology and traceability but cannot substitute for survey, cadastral, traffic, municipal, fire, or heritage data.

assumptions.statement: Conceptual road area is reported as centerline length multiplied by an 18 m discussion width so that the formula is explicit and replaceable.
assumptions.impact: The value is not a road redline, right-of-way, statutory land-use area, or engineering section.

assumptions.statement: AI scenarios use public, synthetic, or cleared data only, with human review, data minimization, visible limits, and user withdrawal before any live test.
assumptions.impact: Scenario cards are operating hypotheses and do not establish deployment, tenant, investment, procurement, or government commitment.
